high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the website ndtv.com. The article is titled "PM Modi Meets Mexican President On Sidelines Of G7 Summit." The content of the article discusses a meeting between Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum at the sidelines of the G7 Summit in Kananaskis, Alberta. The article mentions that the Ministry of External Affairs shared details about the meeting on X (formerly known as Twitter), stating that the purpose of the meeting was to boost warm and historical ties between India and Mexico.
